name: branchleft-shared-infra
comment: No Pulumi program lives at the repository root any more -- the GCP edge program (edge.ts and friends) was removed in the GCP wind-down (branchLeft/workspace#1000) once the GCP estate was destroyed. What remains here is sites.ts/siteTypes.ts, the hostname registry the Hetzner Caddy renderer in hetzner/edge/ still reads, plus this typecheck/format tooling. Neither needs @pulumi/gcp or @pulumi/pulumi.
